results.title: Envy/Desire
results.overview: New York transsexual socialite Bella thinks she has scored the masculine hetero man of her dreams. The illusion is shattered when her best friend Natasha tells her Ethan, might not be the man she thinks he is; in fact, he might not want to be a man at all.

results.title: Summer Rain
results.overview: The alluring sounds of violin music bring back memories that reunite a father and daughter separated at birth. Though neither realized what had happened in the past, they were unmistakably drawn to each other when they did meet.

results.title: Diamond
results.overview: Set in 2006 amidst the diamond mining rush that started in Zimbabwe. To claim back their land, the Toropito brothers have to raise enough money to buy it back, forcing them to join the illegal diamond mining world.

results.title: Bougainvillea
results.overview: A family entangled in a police investigation surrounding the mysterious disappearance of tourists in Kerala.

results.title: Agency
results.overview: A man seeking revenge for his sister's torment kidnaps a world-famous pop star with unexpected consequences.

results.title: Three Wiser Men and a Boy
results.original_title: Three Wiser Men and a Boy
results.overview: Five years after the events of the first film, Christmas is once again just around the corner. In a crazy turn of events, possibly brought on accidently by the brothers themselves, the director of Luke’s son Thomas’ school holiday musical steps down. Luke, desperate to make his son’s stage dreams come true, enlists the help of his brothers Taylor and Stephan. The trio also find themselves meeting their mother's new boyfriend and the brothers grapple with their own feelings about this relationship. In true Brenner brother fashion, they are all in for a Christmas they will never forget.

results.title: Codename: Devil
results.overview: A veteran returns home for his father's funeral, only to find himself waging a new war when horrifying secrets come to light.

results.title: The Apocalypse of St John
results.overview: Embark on an epic journey through time and faith with 'The Apocalypse of Saint John.' Join the Apostle John in a stunning visual narrative that unravels the visions of the End Times. Experience each vision like never before, with striking visual effects and epic scenes that immerse you in the apocalyptic narrative.

results.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Road to the Top Movie
results.original_title: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー ROAD TO THE TOP
results.overview: Theatrical version of Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - ROAD TO THE TOP which includes new extra scenes.

results.title: Nada Por Hacer
results.overview: Marcos is a boy obsessed with cleanliness and order. One day, his OCD will be threatened with the arrival of Pedro. He is a dirty plumber who must check and fix the plumbing in his apartment, compulsorily. In this way, Marcos will have to confront his condition and do everything in his power to return to his perfect daily life.

results.title: The 4:30 Movie
results.overview: In the summer of 1986, three sixteen year old friends spend their Saturdays sneaking into movies at the local multiplex. But when one of the guys also invites the girl of his dreams to see the latest comedy, each of the teens learn more about life and love.

results.title: The Greatest Love Story Never Told
results.original_title: The Greatest Love Story Never Told
results.overview: Follow Jennifer Lopez as she attempts her most daring project yet: independently producing a new album and cinematic original that explore her twenty-year journey to self-love.

results.title: No pisar
results.overview: They're kicking us out of our cities, and something has to be done about it, right?

results.title: Chico
results.overview: Jojo, a clumsy, goofy young gay squatter, sets out to repair a washing machine in order to satisfy Lucien, the object of his desires. He wanders around Brussels on a frantic quest, ready to take any risk to achieve his goal.

results.title: Orlando
results.overview: With an original staging of text and music, Orlando follows the trail of one of the greatest composers of the Renaissance: Orlando di Lasso (also known as Roland de Lassus). His life and masterful oeuvre continue to move people to this day.  Although he was a European star at the time, di Lasso had to endure the indignities of his social status as a servant. This documentary explores the relationship between art and power, musically accompanied by the ensemble La Tempête.

results.title: Stripped: Nashville
results.overview: This observational documentary follows the lives of Nashville's most dynamic exotic dancers over the course of several days - highlighting their skills as dancers, upbringing, personal relationships and business acumen.

results.title: The Seasons
results.overview: Egocentric stage actor Marcin has to face the unexpected breakdown of a long-term relationship. During three different performances, fantasy mixes with the prose of the life of a separating couple.

results.title: The Stork
results.overview: A sleepy Montenegrin village, where most of the natives have emigrated to the US, is the setting for a bitter-sweet tale of three women fighting for autonomy. Suta resists pressure to marry her late husband’s autistic twin, Vezire and Drane must learn to coexist as their mutual husband plans to leave, and Fize tries to find a bride for her son. A stork’s arrival troubles the superstitious villagers.

results.title: Copy
results.overview: A woman uneasy about her pregnancy learns the copier isn't just for paper.
